why: The three classes SKILL.md declares partially executed have no member map; this ledger names every member, the receipt that proves an execution and a detector-backed reason for every member the lane has not replayed offline. It is gated by plans/round78_c1_class_member_ledger.py (R78-C1).

filter-js-from-html.note: the grader drives selenium/chromedriver against the filtered HTML; the lane performs no browser execution

git-multibranch.note: the grader writes a verify.sh that apt-get installs curl/expect/git/openssh-client and then drives ssh push + nginx TLS

headless-terminal.note: the grader imports the candidate's own `headless_terminal` package; the lane stages end states, never a candidate implementation

install-windows-3.11.note: the grader asserts on a live qemu-system process, its /proc cmdline, a netstat listener and a qemu monitor socket

query-optimize.note: the grader sha256-pins /app/oewn.sqlite and reads /tests/golden.sql, then takes a median runtime ratio over five iterations
